test_item:
The software shall start the key installation process if the USB device/SDCard is inserted with the available key material present in the specified external storage directory.
(not valid private keys; verification fails and stored keys are removed)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. A USB drive containing not valid private keys has been inserted into the HU USB port
proc:
1. Read the installation state file in the secure partition
$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/installstate
2. Confirm the content of /mnt/vendor/oemkeys on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /mnt/vendor/oemkeys
er:
1. The adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/installstate output shows the installstate value 3
2. The adb shell ls -l /mnt/vendor/oemkeys output lists no stored key material
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-KeyInsyall-002 Requirement Description and Verification Criteria
source: Z1 IntegrationTests/PythonTests/common/keys_install_helper.py (installstate path and state values verbatim)
sibling axis: verification outcome; rule 1,4 of SEC-04 4.2
channel_feasible: Y/Y
